name: csp-wildcard-subdomains-vs-exact
hook: CSP wildcard subdomains don't match exact subdomains — add both
body:
In Content Security Policy, `*.example.com` (wildcard subdomain) does NOT match `www.example.com` (specific subdomain). They are distinct entries in the source list. Gravatar avatars are loaded from `www.gravatar.com`, so both `*.gravatar.com` AND `www.gravatar.com` must be in img-src for admin routes.

Fix: Add both the wildcard and the specific subdomain to img-src — e.g. `*.gravatar.com www.gravatar.com`.
why: The admin CSP had `*.gravatar.com` but test expected `www.gravatar.com`. The wildcard only matches subdomains like `anything.gravatar.com`, not `www` exactly.
